name: celikom
description: CELIKOM monorepository: browser extension, service foundation and validated playback PoC

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:server
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run validate && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:poc && npm run test:extension && npm run test:server
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-repository.mjs && node scripts/validate-poc.mjs && npm --prefix extension run validate
